# Code on the Go (GPL-3.0)

GEIVIA incorporates or is derived in part from **Code on the Go**,  
an open-source Android IDE by App Dev for All.

- Project: https://github.com/appdevforall/CodeOnTheGo
- Website: https://appdevforall.org/code-on-the-go/
- License: GNU General Public License v3.0

## License obligations

Because Code on the Go is licensed under GPL-3.0 and GEIVIA is also GPL-3.0,
any distributed version of GEIVIA that includes Code on the Go code must:

- Remain under GPL-3.0
- Make the complete corresponding source available
- Preserve copyright and license notices

## Current status

This directory documents the intent to incorporate Code on the Go components.
Full integration is incremental (terminal, build system, editor, LSP, etc.).

See also: ../README.md and the root LICENSE file.
